Chekhov's Gun:Rin taking the boxcutter in Episode 23. Conveniently Seated: He sits in the second-to-last seat along the left windows. Dark and Troubled Past:It involves his parents' death and years of torment by Kaede. Deadpan Snarker:Appropriately voicedbyTomokazu Sugita.

characters.name: Shuffle Heroines
characters.description: The daughter of the King of the Gods, Lisianthus, or Sia for short, met Rin when she was eight years old in the human world, having wandered away from her father's business meeting out of boredom. Rin befriends her on that day, causing Sia to fall in love with him. Accidental Kiss:With Kaede in the ending credits of the final episode. Ascended Extra: Her sister in 'her' ending in the original Shuffle had an agreement with Sia that they would share their time and body with Rin. In Essence+, Sia's ending is replaced with Kikyo's and Kikyo gets a new extended branching where Sia's ended that deals with some light political intrigue for the cause ofusing devil world magitek to split Sia and Kikyo apart and then having them both marry Rin because Eustoma can't publicly admit that his daughter is a devil even if he's concerned for her and wants Sia and Kikyo to remain family even if they can't be sisters. Book Dumb: Eustoma almost destroyed the school because Sia was in danger of failing. Chairman of the Brawl: Usually uses chairs and benches to hit herBumbling Dadwith.Tick! Tack!would later reveal she picked this up from her mother.

characters.name: On The Stage Heroines
characters.description: Kareha is Asa's friend and also Rin and Kaede's senpai. She is of the God race, and she is known to fall into trances when imagining romantic things, sparkling as she does so. She becomes one of the heroines in On The Stage. Bishie Sparkle: Whenever sheFangirlsaboutanything, she sparkles and says "My my my!" Covert Pervert:Only covert in that she doesn't say out loud what she's imagining. However, whenever a situation that could be construed as romantic or perverted presents itself, she willSqueeand glow. Fangirl: She finds even the slightest hint of Rin in a romance with another girl, she Squees. Fanservice with a Smile: She takes a part time job at the tea shop Flora, notable for their cute waitress outfits.

characters.name: Essence+ Heroines
characters.description: Ms. Beni is the teacher of Rin's class in (apparently) history. She becomes one of the heroines in Essence+. Anchored Ship: Admits to liking Rin, but turns him down because it would be unprofessional. Badass Teacher: How she deals with guys that hit on her qualifies. Hot Teacher: Jealousy of Rin for having so many girls fawning over him aside, Nadeshiko is generally considered among the student body to be the most attractive person in the school, though it very rarely comes up. That said, any students that try flirting get shot down in the form of heavy training regimens... though she admits that if Rin had tried she might have let him continue flirting for a bit. Indirect Kiss: After meeting Rin while out shopping, she makes him buy her a drink as 'punishment' for admitting that he's going to the arcade. She thinks her drink is too sour and switches with Rin, who notices the situation and then recovers while it takes her a few minutes to realize what she just did.

characters.name: Other Characters
characters.description: Itsuki's mantra is to love all girls equally. Academically at the top of Rin and Kaede's class, Itsuki dreams of ending up with a harem consisting of the girls that Rin does not pick. Cooking Duel: Test score comparison with Rin. Handsome Lech: He is successful enough to be given lunchboxes, but is generally shown to be unsuccessful in his attempts to flirt with the main cast. Genre Savvy: Itsuki hides Rin in a broom closet, and then proceeds to point out that he is very lucky to be in his situation, that he needs to choose, and it's a completely understandable sentiment that other men are jealous of him. Informed Ability: Mayumi states that Itsuki is at the top of the class along with Rin and Kaede, but outside histest duelwith Rin, no other mention of his academic prowess is seen.

characters.name: Raito Aioi
characters.description: A student in Class 2A at Verbena Academy. Affectionate Nickname: Kohaku calls him "Rai-chan," while Nelia calls him "Rai-sama." From Roommates to Romance: He pretty much lives alone with his cousin Kohaku. While it remains an innocent cohabitation in other routes, it becomes this trope if she's the selected love interest. Theme Naming: His name comes from the "iolight" gemstone.

characters.name: Lithia
characters.description: The princess of the Gods. Childhood Friends: With Nelia. Cutting Off the Branches:Princess x Princesshas her and Raito as theOfficial Couple. Generation Xerox: Looks incredibly similar toSia, her great-aunt. Harem Seeker: Due to her experience with her father and hispolygamy, her "ideal relationship" involves her having a husband with multiple wives.

characters.name: Carnelian
characters.description: The princess of Demons. Childhood Friends: With Lithia. Contrasting Sequel Main Character: Nelia fulfills the "demon princess with red eyes and long, blue hair" role that Nerine had, but is extraverted and seductive while Nerine was the shy but devoted type. Nelia also admits to not being very good at studying, another contrast to Nerine. Femme Fatale: She clearly wanted to be this, as she entered the story wanting to seduce Raito, the human boy Lithia liked, and then immediately dump him. Needless to say, falling in love with Raito put a damper on that plan. Only Known by Their Nickname: She prefers to go by "Nelia," as she feels her full name is too long.

characters.name: Kirara Kinoshita
characters.description: A first-year in Verbena Academy's drama club. Childhood Friends: With Citrin. Odd Name Out: She's the only newly introduced character whose name does not directly reference a particular gemstone, instead deriving from "kira kira," the Japanese onomatopoeia for something "shiny."

characters.name: Kohaku Anjou
characters.description: Raito's cousin and a third-year in Verbena Academy's drama club. Contrasting Sequel Main Character: In theory , she's holds the position Kaede had as the heroine that the protagonist had known for years before the start of the game. In practice, they're polar opposites: Kaede is great at housework and cooking, Kohaku is horrible at both; Kaede wants nothing more than to take care of Rin, Kohaku wants Raito to take care of her. From Roommates to Romance: She lives at with Raito at his house. Nothing has happened prior to the games start due to her seeing him as family, but it goes straight into this trope if her route is taken. Kissing Cousins: Is a potential love interest despite being related to the protagonists. Parental Abandonment: He parents have already passed on, so she lives with her relatives.

characters.name: Limestone
characters.description: A mysterious girl lacking in facial expressiveness. Expy Coexistence: She's clearly intended to have fill Primula's role, and unlike the other heroines, any differences held between the two are not as immediately obvious. Emotionless Girl: As noted above, you'll be hard-pressed to get a decent expression out of her. Only Known by Their Nickname: She's mostly referred to as "Limes." Theme Naming: She obviously gets her name from "limestone."

characters.name: Rapisu Amaishi
characters.description: A second-year at Verbena that Lithia befriended in the library. She have Raito have met each other. Theme Naming: Her given name is an obvious reference to the gemstone "lapislazuli."

characters.name: Ai Amaishi
characters.description: A mysterious girl with amnesia that suddenly appeared at Verbena. Theme Naming: Her name references "lazulite."

characters.name: Selena
characters.description: A first year at Verbena who serves as the Vice-President of the Student Council. Number Two: As the Student Council Vice-President, she serves as Torajirou's right-hand woman. Theme Naming: Her name references "selenite."

characters.name: Torajirou Jinbo
characters.description: Verbena's Student Council President and Raito's best friend at school. Contrasting Sequel Main Character: Torajirou fulfills the "perverted best friend" role that Itsuki previously held, but while the latter was infamous for his perversion, the former is largely well-respected by his peers as a paragon of common sense, with his true colors being known only by Raito and the teacher. Theme Naming: His name is based on the "tiger's eye" gemstone.

characters.name: Citrin
characters.description: Kirara's classmate who works several part-time jobs. Childhood Friends: With Kirara. Theme Naming: Her name comes from the "citron" quartz.

characters.name: Marin Obsius
characters.description: Raito's classmate with an impressive amount of information of events happening at the school. Contrasting Sequel Main Character: Her heterochromia, half-human status, and role as an informant bring to mind Mayumi. But while Mayumi had a small chest and was a bad student, Marin is buxom and manages to have excellent grades despite sleeping all the time. Half-Human Hybrid: She's half-human, half-god. Theme Naming: Her name comes from both "aquamarine" and "obsidian."

characters.name: Menou Ishitake
characters.description: Raito's homeroom teacher. Contrasting Sequel Main Character: Menou is meant to fulfill the "buxom teacher" role Nadeshiko had in the previous titles, but Nadeshiko was tall and strict, while Menou is petite and carefree. Theme Naming: Her name comes from the "agate" gemstone.

characters.name: Kunzite
characters.description: Lithia's father and the king of Gods. Affectionate Nickname: His friend Chalcedony refers to him as "Kun-chan." Contrasting Sequel Main Character: He has a similar role as Eustoma as the king of God Realm, and even has similar looks and personality. The difference is that Kunzite is portrayed as an intelligent unlike Eustoma was. Polygamy: He's mentioned as having multiple wives. Theme Naming: His name is derived from the "kunzite" gemstone.

characters.name: Flora
characters.description: A maid to the Royal Family in the world of Gods. Theme Naming: Her name is derived from "fluorite."

characters.name: Chalcedony
characters.description: Nelia's father and the king of Demons. Affectionate Nickname: His friend Kunzite refers to him as "Chal-nii." Contrasting Sequel Main Character: While he has a similar role to Forbesii as the king of the Demon Realm, he has a musclebound appearance while Forbesii was on the lean side. Theme Naming: His name comes from the "chalcedony" gemstone.

characters.name: Alexander
characters.description: A butler to the Royal Family in the world of Demons. Theme Naming: His name comes from "alexandrite."

characters.name: Primula
characters.description: A mysterious girl who bears a striking resemblance to Limes. Strong Family Resemblance: Given how Limes is the splitting image of her, the two essentially being "mother and daughter" should come as no surprise.

characters.name: Lisianthus "Sia" Eustoma
characters.description: Cutting Off the Branches:Princess x Princessstates that she had quite the romance with Rin when she was young.

characters.name: Kaede Fuyou
characters.description: TheChildhood Friendto the former King of Gods, Rin.

characters.name: Asa Shigure
characters.description: Primula's friend who lived 100 years ago. She currently serves as Limes's assistant.
